dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: The implementation matches the approved first-slice scope. Actual intended App-user administration-read acceptance and stacked #50/#52 acceptance remain external gates; operator evidence is not user acceptance.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: The new bounds matrix supports Task 1.1 for this code checkpoint: reachable limits have at/over evidence, and structurally unreachable maxima and fixture limits are explicitly explained. Task 4.3 and integration remain open.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: The actual filesystem, CLI, and committed-Git tests cover the documented reachable boundaries, supported and unsupported layouts, pinned reads, malformed inputs, and output redaction. The stated descriptor/projection limits are structurally unreachable; stderr, per-command, and collection-time failure bounds are defensive and not exhaustively fault-injected. Existing bridge tests cover cancellation and slot release.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: The checkpoint records full local verification and exact-current-head hosted verify and guardrails as passed. No repository commands were run during this read-only audit.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: No concrete code or security finding identified. The helper uses pinned no-follow reads, bounded source ownership checks, isolated committed-object reads, fixed Git commands, redacted failures, and bounded process/output handling. No source writes or operator-credential fallback were identified.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: The implementation and evidence preserve the approved bounded, read-only host observation design and explicitly reject unsupported layouts.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: The coverage matrix describes actual boundary evidence and clearly distinguishes stat/identity/platform fixtures from physical large-pack, changed-UID, and Windows execution claims.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: The reviewed scope remains limited to source-backed observations and does not claim process health, capacity, usage, scheduling, or production readiness. Owner planning approval is not reopened.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: Exact-head verification and boundary evidence are recorded. Actual App-user acceptance, stacked prerequisites, and final integration evidence remain pending; administrative-read remains denied/unknown rather than inferred.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: This accepts the technical bounds checkpoint only. Final Done review, protected approvals, integration, and production/product gates remain pending.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: The checkpoint honestly records structural limits, nonphysical fixtures, unexhausted defensive fault bounds, unavailable App-user administration-read, and remaining external gates; it does not claim full Done.
